answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 32 epochs. Receipts are issued in dawn, burned on slash in ripple, and listed in pulse. That removes the yield an attacker would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 177 aliases cost 166 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
